title: Federation: group avatar fetch has no URL, size or integrity check
description: Found by 3pp3 review. Peer/groupUpdate avatarBlobId: 'the receiver MAY fetch this blob from the sending server' with no fetchUrl, size or sha256, so no defined URL, no signing rule (blob-fetch covers fetchUrl only) and no integrity check; updateMetadata changes the avatar but never says it may be fetched. Proposed: an avatar object shaped like an attachment (blobId, size, sha256, fetchUrl) fetched per {#blob-fetch}, for create and updateMetadata.
close_reason: 6gw4: Peer/groupUpdate avatar object (contentType,size,sha256,fetchUrl) fetched per blob-fetch after authorization, verified like attachments; 2zts: 34 bare section numbers replaced with section titles
